newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-CARSON OUT OF INTENSIVE CARE.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-CARSON OUT OF INTENSIVE CARE.

text.p: Veteran jockey Willie Carson has been moved from intensive care a week after suffering serious injury at Newbury races.
A hospital spokeswoman said on Friday: "Mr Carson is satisfactory. He has now been transferred to one of the hospital's surgical wards."
Carson, 53, was kicked by a horse in the paddock and is being treated for severe liver injuries.
